criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Slide 2 a real showstopper idea, counts match, casts right, dark. Slide 1 near car owns the lower half but toy-like kit crossover. Slide 8 broken: person slumped, wheel empty across the cab, no road or seam, pale slab, stray rod. Slide 5 grey-middle frame, stair-stepped cast, muddy groove, aliased graduations. Slide 3 cluttered leaders, dividers as flecks, near rows unlit. Slide 6 blue-violet cars, block skyline, stray sphere, empty asphalt. Kit people on 7 and 9 read as mannequins.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One lot through the deck, one key, the stripe recurs, devices work, value stays dark. Frame 5 a grey slab, frame 8 shares no material or light, frame 6's blue cars.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces; primary sources; rejected list honoured. Slide 8's Permian line looser than c68's customer-owned trucks; slide 4's dek not what the picture shows.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What the list is and who keeps it, the rule, concentration, Dallas's refused ask, the exact route for a concern and the threshold; caption puts the stake to lawmakers.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, 2 pays, turns at 5 and 6, close actionable; 4 largely repeats 3.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on register, regional specificity; slide 1 dek and slide 6 opener flat.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fresh census-as-lot concept; steel rule with graduations repeats 66 to 68; person outside a fence repeats 68; crossover at a stop bar repeats 64's cover; dusk_gold and staged lastLight recently used.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild frame 8 with the person upright behind the wheel, hands on the rim, windshield showing the road and seam.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Person slumped in the near seat, wheel empty across the cab, black windshield, pale slab, stray rod, headliner edges cross the dek.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Passenger-seat camera, person upright behind the wheel, hands on the rim, windshield open to road and seam, delete slab and rod.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Mid-grey slab, stair-stepped cast, muddy groove, graduations alias, dead band between hook and dek.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Dark stainless on a near-black mat, grazing key, taller stop block, smoother shadow, groove albedo within 12 Lab of the accent, close the hook to dek gap.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Leaders cross lit cars, ITE label collides, dividers flecks, near rows unlit.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Labels on dark asphalt beside each run without leaders, pool on the near rows, full-width divider bars.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Blue-violet cars, block skyline with a stray sphere, empty bottom 40 percent.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Cut the cool fill, remove the sphere, tilt down so tail rows fill the lower half.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Lone car in front of a full row, empty bays a sliver, comb shadow from the left edge.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower the camera into the ITE row so nine empty bays lead to the one car, remove the off-frame caster.
